name: True false stamp
summary: Big rotated TRUE (green) or FALSE (red) stamp that slams down; for myth-busting and quiz verdicts.

params.name: color
params.note: stamp colour; default green for TRUE, red for FALSE

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at
